# appgatesdp_replication_target (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `last_replication_details` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_replication_details))
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `replication_tags` (List of String) Tags used for selecting items to replicate to this target. The tag builtin is not permitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `last_replication_time` (String) Last replication timestamp.
- `source_health_message` (String) Source-side health check message that explains a controller-detected issue affecting this target’s status.
- `status` (String) Replication status.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
